channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: 'We're looking forward to a big year from Tony'
item.description: Jack O'Connor was suitably impressed by Tony Brosnan's scoring heroics against Waterford in the McGrath Cup last Sunday.

item.title: LGFA announce winners of 2025 National Volunteer of the Year awards
item.description: The Ladies Gaelic Football Association is pleased to announce the 2025 LGFA Volunteer of the Year award winners.

item.title: Tyrone expect to have McElholm and Canavan for start of the League
item.description: Tyrone boss Malachy O'Rourke is optimistic about Eoin McElholm and Darragh Canavan's chances of being fit for the start of the Allianz Football League against Kildare on Saturday week.

item.title: Arles-Killeen turn to Christie
item.description: Former Dublin full back Paddy Christie has been named as the new senior football manager of Laois club Arles-Killeen.

item.title: Tyrone All-Ireland winning 'keeper and NFL hopeful joins Alabama
item.description: Former Tyrone goalkeeper Lorcan Quinn has moved a step closer to fulfilling his NFL dream by joining college giants Alabama.

item.title: Laochra Gael returns with star-studded line-up
item.description: The line-up for the 24th season of TG4's Laochra Gael has been announced.

item.title: Extra trains for All-Ireland club finals
item.description: Irish Rail is putting on extra trains for Sunday's All-Ireland club finals.

item.title: Munster chief: schedule was too tight for Munster hurling final replay
item.description: Munster GAA CEO Kieran Leddy has claimed the schedule was too tight for last year's Munster SHC final to go to a replay.

item.title: Geaney taking a 'big break' after All-Ireland club final
item.description: Paul Geaney is unlikely to play any part in Kerry's upcoming Allianz Football League defence after revealing that he plans on taking a break after Sunday's All-Ireland club SFC final.

item.title: Connacht GAA air dome set to reopen
item.description: The Connacht GAA air dome which was destroyed by Storm Eowyn a year ago is set to reopen in April.
